evidence.observation: Tube pressure climbing monotonically through growth (2.99→3.11→3.20→3.28 Torr) while Ar flow and T are at setpoint
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: close Ar and watch whether pressure still rises = leak, or drops slowly = restriction) to distinguish seal leak from exhaust blockage
